clinic.name: City Clinic

hours.saturday: 9 AM to 1 PM for limited appointments

clinic.arrival_guidance: Patients may arrive 15 to 30 minutes early for check-in. Arriving early does not move the appointment time unless the front desk confirms an earlier slot.
clinic.parking: Validated parking is available in the Market Street Garage. Street parking is limited.
clinic.reschedule_policy: The clinic can note a preferred new day or time during the reminder call. Final availability is confirmed by the scheduling desk.
clinic.cancellation_policy: Patients can cancel from the reminder call. The clinic may follow up if another appointment is needed.
clinic.emergency_guidance: For urgent symptoms or emergencies, patients should call emergency services or go to the nearest emergency department.
